answer: In an economy of AI agents, economic staking prevents Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic collateral to join the network. Like burning timber to fuel a forge, malicious agents must lock up capital that acts as a financial ember, slashing their balance if they lie. This immutable economic ledger maps every participant like an atlas, making the cost of spinning up fake identities prohibitively expensive because each false node drains scarce tokens from the attacker.
